plan.purpose: Help the person checking an extracted invoice verify the payable amount, identify the transaction, and inspect the supporting details without wading through raw receipt text.
plan.title: Review the invoices
plan.composition: Open with a full-width ResultHeader, then repeat one spacious, flat invoice record for each item in /result, preserving list order. Each record leads with its total including tax, followed by the vendor and transaction details; a compact three-column band groups the date, invoice number and document type, stacking on narrow screens. Keep purchase and party details in an unboxed reading column, and fold tax detail, registration details and source text into a closed Collapsible at the end of each record. Separate records with hairlines, use only h1 and h2 headings, and use theme-aware text and borders rather than colour alone; there are no side panels, request summaries or run controls.

regions.purpose: Name the result and provide the placement for the host-owned result actions.
elements: ResultHeader — title "Review the invoices" as the page's only h1; no state binding, eyebrow or subtitle; host-owned result actions at the right.

regions.purpose: Let the reviewer read each extracted invoice as a self-contained record, starting with the amount they need to check.
elements: Stack — repeat over /result using $state; all following relative paths read from the current item with $item, except delegated subtrees passed literally to MthdsResult.
Detail — amount_incl_tax; label "Total including tax"; place first and give its bound value the strongest typographic emphasis in the record; no currency suffix because the result carries none.
Heading — vendor; h2; omit when empty.
Grid — three columns containing the issue date, invoice number and document type; stack on narrow screens.
DateText — issue_date; long format, muted tone.
Detail — invoice_number; label "Invoice number".
Badge — category/category; display the bound value, "bill" or "receipt", without inventing a status.
Detail — time; label "Transaction time".
Detail — description; label "Purchased".
Detail — vendor_address; label "Seller address".
Detail — company_name; label "Buyer".
Detail — company_address; label "Buyer address".
Collapsible — trigger "Tax and source details"; initially closed; contains a Stack with the elements listed in the next region.
Separator — between repeated invoice records only.

regions.title: Tax and source details
regions.purpose: Keep the evidence and less frequently needed accounting details available within each invoice without crowding the initial reading.
elements: Stack — the content of the preceding record's Collapsible, inside the same /result repeat; not a separate page-level section.
Grid — two columns containing the net amount and tax amount; stack on narrow screens.
Detail — amount_excl_tax; label "Amount excluding tax"; no currency suffix.
Detail — vat_amount; label "Tax amount"; no currency suffix.
MthdsResult — vat_rates; relative path within each /result item; label "Tax rates"; delegate the numeric list whole, and omit when null or empty.
Detail — vendor_siret; label "Seller SIRET".
Detail — vendor_vat_number; label "Seller VAT number".
Detail — category/explanation; label "Why this document type".
MthdsResult — text; relative path within each /result item; label "Extracted text"; delegate the source text whole.

delegated: vat_rates — relative to each item in /result; delegate the numeric list whole to MthdsResult.
text — relative to each item in /result; delegate the raw extracted source text whole to MthdsResult.

# Result page: invoice_extraction.process_invoice

Process relevant information from an invoice

## Frame

This page is the result page of an app that is composed, then shows its result: what the person sees after one run. The host draws what surrounds it: the band with the team's logo and the app's name, then a bar restating the request with a way back to edit it and to run again. The host also owns the actions on the result, such as downloading or sharing it, and places them where the page's header puts them. There is no side panel, no app bar and no footer to build, and nothing restates the request.

The page is the result across the full width. It opens on its header, which names the result in a person's words, read from the result itself where it can be (the page's h1). Then the figure or the fact a person looks for first, then the body of the result in the shape it naturally has: a plan day by day, options side by side to compare, a record's details. Lay out what a person reads; leave out what only a machine would.

Show each value once: a figure a component already states, such as the total inside a ProportionBar, is not repeated beside it. When the result carries the request back - the same facts the person entered, such as the topic or the tone they chose - leave that part out: the host's bar already restates the request. Write a value as a person reads it: a date in words, an amount beside its currency when the result has one.

## State

The host loads the run's result under `/result` before the page renders. Read every value with `$state`; emit no `/state` patches. Paths:

- `/result` — list of structure invoice_extraction.Invoice — `output`: Invoice information extracted from text, supporting both formal bills and receipts
  - each item is a structure invoice_extraction.Invoice (Invoice information extracted from text, supporting both formal bills and receipts), with these members (paths relative to one item, for DataTable columns or $item):
    - `invoice_id` — text — `invoice_id`: Unique identifier for the invoice
    - `invoice_number` — text — `invoice_number`: Invoice number as shown on the document
    - `issue_date` — date — `issue_date`: Date when the invoice was issued
    - `time` — text — `time`: Time of the transaction if available
    - `amount_incl_tax` — number — `amount_incl_tax`: Total amount including taxes
    - `amount_excl_tax` — number — `amount_excl_tax`: Net amount excluding taxes
    - `vat_amount` — number — `vat_amount`: Total VAT/tax amount
    - `vat_rates` — list of number — `vat_rates`: List of VAT rates applied
      - each item is a number
    - `vendor` — text — `vendor`: Name of the vendor/seller
    - `vendor_address` — text — `vendor_address`: Complete address of the vendor
    - `vendor_siret` — text — `vendor_siret`: SIRET number of the vendor (French company registration)
    - `vendor_vat_number` — text — `vendor_vat_number`: VAT registration number of the vendor
    - `company_name` — text — `company_name`: Name of the purchasing company
    - `company_address` — text — `company_address`: Address of the purchasing company
    - `description` — text — `description`: Description of goods or services purchased
    - `category` — structure invoice_extraction.InvoiceDetails — `category`: Category or type of expense
      - `category/category` — choice of "bill" | "receipt" — `category`: The category of the invoice
      - `category/explanation` — text — `explanation`: Explanation of the classification
    - `text` — text — `text`: Raw text extracted from the invoice

## Delegated

None. `MthdsResult` remains available for any structure you choose not to lay out.

## One real run, as loaded

The state of one actual run, so you can judge magnitudes and lengths. Bind to the paths; do not copy these values into the spec.
